card.name: Names and places in tropical-region web text
card.fires_on: Fires on the middle of a person's name or a date, often a non-European name, in web text about climate, tropical places or fish. It also appears on some linking words in such articles.

modes.label: Partway through personal names
modes.description: Inside or just after a first name or title, before the rest of a foreign surname.

modes.label: Year in a citation
modes.description: The space or digit within a year after an author's initials in a reference list.

modes.label: Linking words in tropical-city text
modes.description: Small connecting words in prose about a tropical city or region.

card.writes: It promotes Russian and German name pieces and suppresses tropical and Southeast Asian place words, so it seems to steer away from tropical-region words.
card.plain: It lights up on pieces of foreign names and dates in articles about tropical places, and it pushes against more tropical-place words.
